summary: Tested mandatory KYC backend + frontend on public URL. Core KYC flow passed (checklist, upload limits, private KTP, reviewer RBAC, lock overlay/nav lock, responsive overflow). One regression failure found: demo verified-label workflow is blocked because demo_vip is currently not KYC-verified (missing logo+bank), so core endpoints still return KYC_REQUIRED.

critical.issue: Regression workflow for verified label failed: demo_vip KYC state is incomplete (missing_keys: logo, bank), and /api/releases/ returns 403 KYC_REQUIRED.

integration_issues.issue: Support can open /admin/kyc page and filters/queue shell, but queue was empty in current environment so preview image + approve/reject action flow could not be fully validated in browser run.

action_items: Fix regression fixture/data for expected verified label workflow (demo_vip should have complete KYC prerequisites + verified document, or update test account/docs to a truly verified label).
Re-run frontend admin /admin/kyc with at least one pending_review item to validate preview + reject-required-reason + approve actions end-to-end in UI.
After data fix, retest /api/label/kyc and /api/releases/ for verified-label non-blocking behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: KTP private file protection is correctly enforced: /api/files/kyc-private/* returns 404 while owner/reviewer private endpoints still work.
Reviewer RBAC is correctly hardened in backend: only super_admin/admin_support can access queue/detail/file/action; finance gets 403.

KYC gate UX behavior is aligned: restricted routes remain rendered but blurred with overlay; allowed tabs (dashboard/profile/contract) stay accessible; notification bell remains usable for unverified labels.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (critical KYC lock/gate/RBAC/responsive checks passed; admin queue detail action flow blocked by empty queue data)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed retained. Temporary phase66-* records created by tests were cleaned in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use new regression file /app/backend/tests/test_iter56_phase66_kyc_extended.py. Current env has no pending_review item for support UI queue validation. demo_vip currently returns KYC incomplete (missing logo+bank), causing verified-label regression test failure.
rca of the issue: RCA (verified-label regression): test login for demo_vip succeeds, but GET /api/label/kyc returns status=incomplete with missing_keys=[logo, bank], document=null, is_verified=false. Consequently protected core endpoint /api/releases/ responds 403 KYC_REQUIRED. Root cause appears to be fixture/data-state mismatch for expected verified regression account, not reviewer/KYC enforcement logic itself.
